findings.location: HTML, opening paragraph and paragraphs describing the visit and conversation
findings.source_quote: “a friend asked my husband” … “outside his sister’s home” … “Our friend talked, pleading with his sister and brother-in-law”
findings.suggested_fix: Use masculine forms for the friend throughout, consistent with the later “his sister” and “brother-in-law”: for example, change “eine Freundin” to “ein Freund,” “unserer Freundin” to “unserem Freund,” and “Unsere Freundin” to “Unser Freund.” Adjust the associated possessive forms accordingly.
findings.translation_quote: „…“, fragte eine Freundin meinen Mann. … mit unserer Freundin vor dem Haus ihrer Schwester. … Unsere Freundin redete und flehte ihre Schwester und ihren Schwager an …

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “Every day I choose to honor or dishonor”
findings.source_quote: “My choice determines the reciprocating favor or loss.”
findings.suggested_fix: Revise this sentence to preserve the idea that her choice affects whether favor is reciprocated or lost, without changing whose affection is being reciprocated. For example: “Meine Entscheidung beeinflusst, ob Zuneigung erwidert wird oder verloren geht.”
findings.translation_quote: Meine Entscheidung bestimmt, ob mir seine Zuneigung erwidert wird oder verloren geht.

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “I think of the wayward lady in town”
findings.source_quote: “who was chased from home by her children”
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the case and phrasing to “die von ihren eigenen Kindern aus dem Haus gejagt wurde.”
findings.translation_quote: die vom eigenen Kindern aus dem Haus gejagt wurde
